text.p: Following is a factfile on Rivaldo, who moved to Barcelona from Deportivo La Coruna on Friday for four billion pesetas ($25.7 million).
Full name: Rivaldo Vito Barba Ferreira.
1992: Signs professional terms with Santa Cruz.
1993: Moves to Corinthians for one season. Makes international debut in friendly against Mexico, scoring only goal in 1-0 win.
1994: Transferred to Palmeiras. Misses out on Brazil squad that goes on to win World Cup
1996: Moves to Spain to join Deportivo La Coruna. Scores 21 goals in his 41 league games during the 1996-97 season.

July 17, 1997: Plays last game for Deportivo, helping them to win the pre-season Teresa Herrera tournament. Deportivo beat PSV Eindhoven 4-3 on penalties after drawing 2-2 with Rivaldo scoring the final successful penalty.
August 15, 1997: Transfer to Barcelona for four billion pesetas ($25.7 million) confirmed.
